statement: SDL Triton classifies 28de:1303 as the same Triton controller type as wired 28de:1302. The reviewed driver decodes input 0x42 and BLE-named 0x45 using a common no-quaternion field prefix, additionally supports 0x47 with a distinct timestamp representation, and handles 0x43 battery. Its lizard-disable SET on feature ID 1 repeats roughly every 3000 ms, sensor support assumes 4032 us per update, and it resends ordinary 0x80 rumble after 40 ms. The exact D9 revision sends that rumble via SDL_hid_write; the later 531acc revision instead uses SDL_HIDAPI_SendRumble and supports short 0x81-0x85 effects. These are versioned consumer implementation choices, not measured BLE device rates. SDL controller_list.h lines 672-675; SDL Triton driver lines 130-146,243-379,436-458,483-565,568-697; structs lines 550-560,609-697.

applicability.revision: host sources Linux v7.3, SDL e0232c5 and 531acc, BlueZ aa4f5ce; device firmware not measured
applicability.scope: Consumer source evidence, not physical Bluetooth or virtual-host observation. No private-SDL live BLE consumer test has been run here.
